reply:
[Open Cupboard Ledger](./index.html) in a browser. The complete offline tool is contained in that single file.

It tracks tables **T-01** and **T-02** and projector **P-01** individually, plus **three extension cords** by quantity. Volunteers can record checkouts and partial returns, see overdue loans, reserve equipment, check date-range availability, and print the current loans sheet.

Reservation ranges include both endpoints. When a request exceeds capacity, the app identifies the date, household, and loan or reservation causing the conflict.

The ledger is saved in the browser on the device. Use the same file and browser profile for each shift. I verified persistence after reload, partial returns, overlap handling, and print-to-PDF output.
